justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Platform-specific training; no clinical outcome studies.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Platform-specific online training; low cost and time; quick to obtain.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in occupational health and work injury settings; limited to Occupro platform users.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Work health assessments billable under ergonomic and FCE codes; platform-based billing modest.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Very limited employer demand; proprietary platform certification with niche recognition.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Worker satisfaction with platform-delivered assessments not studied.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Industrial/work comp/FCE is paid by employers and carriers, not consumers; near-zero cash-pay.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Contracted rates with employers, with modest premiums for FCE/work-conditioning services.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Differentiates from generic outpatient PT in industrial markets but is one of several brands.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Excellent — service is protocolized, B2B contracts scale, and clinicians are interchangeable.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Recognized by HR/safety/employer buyers, not consumers.
justifications.business.efficiency: Relatively accessible cost/time with quick deployability into a clinic.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Commercial vendor credential; carries little academic weight.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Some relevance in industrial/ergonomics electives, otherwise narrow.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: FCE literature is mixed with significant reliability/validity concerns.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Essentially never listed in faculty postings.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Cheap/fast relative to academic alternatives but low academic return.
